beats.say: Walter Koenig lived for 32,913 days, spanning roughly 90 years of history.
He was one of just two actors to audition for the role of Pavel Chekov.
He was cast because he resembled Davy Jones of the Monkees.
He went on to appear in 36 episodes of the original series.
Years later he returned as Admiral Chekov in the 2015 fan film Renegades.
From Chicago to the stars, his incredible journey touched generations of fans.

facts: Walter Marvin Koenig lived from September 14, 1936 to October 25, 2026.
He was one of only two actors to audition for the role of Ensign Pavel Chekov.
Koenig was cast as Chekov because he resembled Davy Jones of the Monkees.
Koenig appeared in 36 episodes of Star Trek: The Original Series.
Koenig played Admiral Chekov in the 2015 fan film Star Trek: Renegades.
